findings.title: Recitation forms embodied response
findings.claim: Ismail's household instruction can also be heard as formation of a close community capable of receiving signs so deeply that instruction matures into spontaneous prostration and tears across a lineage.
findings.mechanism: The closing collective is guided and selected; when signs are recited, they fall in prostration and tears. The focus household command now reads as intergenerational formation toward an immediate embodied and affective response, not bare external compliance.
findings.reader_payoff: Prayer becomes a practiced capacity to receive: the household command points toward a community whose hearing of signs becomes bodily and emotionally visible.
findings.containment: This is qualified, attributed pericope evidence. The closing collective may summarize all named prophets without asserting that Ismail's instruction caused its response; the focus remains a direct command to his household.

epistemic.reason: The exact anchors and supplied roles are complete in the declared pericope, but the HFT reader identity is legacy_unbound and target morphology is not independently supplied, so the finding remains attributed.

findings.title: Prayer as a relay of following
findings.claim: Prayer also images a relay discipline that keeps the household close behind a prophetic forerunner so that successors can continue the course.
findings.mechanism: The focus household and prayer carriers meet the mapped follower-behind-the-forerunner branches, while the nearby following and recitation occurrences anchor that race image to prophetic sequence and formation.
findings.reader_payoff: The household command can be pictured as a practice that stays close behind a model and carries the course onward.
findings.containment: This is exploratory, attributed evidence. The race image is branch-distant and surprising; it is rendered only as a relay metaphor for formation, never as a lexical replacement of salah with racing.

epistemic.reason: The packet supplies exact focus and pericope coordinates and explicitly contains the outlier as a metaphor; its reader identity remains legacy_unbound, so the image stays exploratory and attributed.

findings.title: Approval as entrusted reliability
findings.claim: The focus's approval can also image being trusted before his Lord as a reliable guarantor of sustained household practice.
findings.mechanism: The focus mardiyyan branches preserve obedient, loving, and guarantor roles, while the preceding fulfilled promise supplies the test of reliability. The household branch provides what is placed within that trusted person's care.
findings.reader_payoff: Approval becomes an entrusted role: the reader can feel the favorable standing as reliability answerable for a household practice.
findings.containment: This is exploratory, attributed evidence. The guarantor image is surprising because the surface directly states divine approval; it is anchored in the mapped r-d-w/r-d-y inventories and fulfilled-promise contact, but it is not the adjective's exclusive grammatical meaning.

epistemic.reason: The packet explicitly contains the outlier and its containment; exact focus/context coordinates agree, but legacy_unbound provenance and the role-image status keep the finding exploratory.

findings.title: The personal Rabb within a wider lordship
findings.claim: The focus's personal رَبِّهِۦ can also be heard, under the explicitly added 1:2 overlay, within a lordship extending over the worlds.
findings.mechanism: The focus lordship occurrence is the carrier, and the external word عَٰلَمِينَ supplies a specific scope trigger; the contact widens the scale of the relation while the personal genitive remains.
findings.reader_payoff: The same title can be held as intimate relation and wider scope of authority without turning the focus ayah into a whole-surah reading.
findings.containment: This is only the 1:2 overlay on the focus Lord-relation. It does not replace the personal relation, import the rest of the Fatiha, or claim that every external ayah contributes to this focus.

epistemic.reason: The external member supplies exact Arabic surface evidence and a concrete scope word; the added interpretation is a bounded discovery inference without a separate support record.
